name: FastH3-Omni by Reactor
description: Create video with synchronized sound on Reactor.

paragraphs: An official Reactor demo for composing a short video clip with synchronized sound. The Space uses the Reactor JavaScript SDK and reactor-queue in the browser, with the model fixed to reactor/fast-h3-omni. Its three examples attach their displayed images as visual references. The guided action, dialogue, camera, soundscape, and music fields compile a compact one-shot prompt using MiniMax H3's integratedmultimodaldescription, overallsoundscape, and nondiegeticmusic structure. Spoken lines receive stable speaker IDs and [English] ... tags inside the shot. The full-prompt editor remains…

The visual system follows the Reactor Guidelines / Master File: Interstellar black, Dune #C7C099, Whiteout white, Aeonik, IBM Plex Mono, and the official Reactor SVG wordmark. Brand fonts load from docs.reactor.inc with cross-origin access.
